overview: A comprehensive house construction planning web app that guides users through every stage of building — from GPS-based site surveying and field measurements to 3D blueprinting, structural planning, and interior finishes. Designed for both homeowners and professional architects.
features: GPS/GNSS field measurement tool with real-time location tracking
Interactive map with waypoint placement and polygon drawing
Automatic area, perimeter, and distance calculations
Save and manage land plots with names, dates, and notes
Walk-with-GPS mode for automatic boundary capture
Construction workflow integration with JSON export
